subject: Only show valid dates in dateInput

messages.author: 6292d2e69b07aa0d
messages.subject: Only show valid dates in dateInput
parts:
Is there a way to only show certain dates in dateInput/dateRangeInput (or via some other combo of other functions) or is it only possible to set min and max dates. I currently have it set up to dynamically pick the date range but not all dates within that range contain data. I would like to still show the whole calendar since it looks nice for dates but in the code below I would like ymd(unique(sub$date)) to show up as selectable in the calendar. For dateRangeInput its not as big of a deal but it could be confusing if someone selects a range and data doesnt show up with dates right up to the range they select

Thanks, Jake

    output$dates <- renderUI({
        if (is.null(input$pitcher_full_name)) return()
        nm <- pfx$full_name.pit == input$pitcher_full_name
        sub <- pfx[ffwhich(pfx, nm),]
        range.date <- ymd(range(sub$date))

        dateRangeInput(
            "date",
            "Date",
            min = range.date[1],
            max = range.date[2]
            )
    })
